_comment: Mutation survivors accepted as a baseline for the core sweep. The nightly ratchet fails when a survivor appears outside this set, and when an entry is no longer a survivor. Regenerate with `python scripts/mutation_gate.py --baseline core --update` after a sweep, and only ever let this set shrink. Entries are the survivor line without its line:col position, so they survive unrelated code motion.

_accepted.crates/valgebra-core/src/decision.rs: de: Every branch dropped is a refutation the arm names directly, and the goal reads it against its subject where it returns (`witnessed`). Deleting the arm hands the empty list to the general union rule as a union of no branches, which declines `A ⊆ ∅` for many a subject it cannot read: 561 of the 1,088 visits the core suite makes, each read on the longer route beside the arm's own answer. Every one is recovered further on by the same query: a narrowing by the cheap disjointness is the cheap disjointness of the whole union, which `unstructured` refutes on by construction, and one by the full reading is refuted by a reference's reduction or by the set representation the decision asks next. So no answer moves and the work does -- a decline where the arm refutes, then a second route to the same refutation -- and a test could see only the intermediate answer, which is a detail of the route rather than a claim of the relation.
_accepted.crates/valgebra-core/src/decision/record: `maps == 0 || removed == 0` becomes `maps == 0 && removed == 0`, which lets a meet with keyed maps and no complement, or complements and no keyed map, past the guard. Both answer `Unknown` on the other side of it, with nothing read that a test can see: with no positive map `split_the_maps` finds none and declines, and with no complement `split_across` has no branch and declines. The guard is cost alone, keeping the set guard's walk and the maps' reading off the meets that cannot be a difference of maps, which every declined meet holding a keyed map reaches.

`maps < 2 || !branches.any(..)` becomes `maps < 2 && !branches.any(..)`, which lets a meet holding one keyed map or none, or a supertype holding none, past the guard. None of them answers otherwise: with no positive map `split_the_maps` declines; with one, the member rule asked before this has put that map against the supertype, which is what splitting the one map asks, and a refutation from it beside another member is taken as a proof or nothing; and with no map among the branches `split_across` has no branch and declines. The guard is cost alone.

`types.len() > 1` skips the meet of a key's types where one map gives the key a type, and that case reaches only a meet with an open map: every closed map declares every required key or the meet is empty above, so with every map closed a required key has a type from each. The open path answers by R◦ (`record_of_maps_verdict`), whose label for the key is the same meet with the clauses' values beside it, so an empty single type returns `Empty` there too, and `>=` moves only when the meet is computed, never the answer. Held by `a_record_meet_is_empty_only_where_a_required_key_cannot_hold`, which reads the single-type case `Empty` either way.

With one clause of the supertype holding the value, the cover asks whether the clause's key holds the subject's key and its value the subject's value, which is the one-clause test `subsumed` asks of every clause just before it, so where the cover would answer the clause has answered already. The mutant asks that clause again, at the cost of a second inclusion and no answer moved.
_accepted.crates/valgebra-core/src/decision/emptin: The disjunct reads a union empty where each member is, and `is_empty_with` reads the same of a union the step after (`emptiness_on`, through `read_as_a_relation_empty`, which asks each member's `emptiness_under` first), so dropped there the union is answered `Empty` one step on. The other callers of `empty_under` pass a meet with a table's complement (`decided_as_respelled`), which a union subject leaves a meet, so no union reaches the disjunct but through `is_empty_with`. The mutant moves which line answers, not the answer.
